about: Words never sent for AI examples, whatever their meaning source says: their core meaning is uncertain. Remove an entry only after the meaning has been checked (and corrected in dictionary_overrides.json if needed).

words.reason: ECDICT only has the slang verb 'show off' (卖弄); the food is spelled 'hot dog'. Low learning value as it stands.
Several equally common senses (流行音乐, 砰的一声, 突然出现); the chosen core (使发出爆裂声) is not clearly the main one.
WordNet chose n. 愉快, but the school sense is 欢呼 (vi./n.); needs a decision before generation.
